meta.title: MCP kit
meta.description: Declares every MCP server you use in one place and connects them through the MCP manager. Currently connects the official LingXing (领星 ERP) server, whose tools appear as mcp__lingxing__<tool>. Add a server by editing the patch and keys.env.example, then update this plugin; per-server keys stay in the credential store. Disabling the plugin disconnects every server it declares.
